QuestInfo.name: Rise of the Alliance
QuestInfo.0: You received a surprise message from #p1105012#!
QuestInfo.1: #p1105012# showed you an invitation to the continental conference sent by the #p1101000# Knights. She's excited to see you finally being recognized as a true Hero.
QuestInfo.2: #p1105012# showed you an invitation to the continental conference sent by the #p1101000# Knights. She's excited to see you finally being recognized as a true Hero. You have traveled to Ereve and met the Cygnus Empress. Could this little girl really be an Empress?

0.0: Aran! Sorry to interrupt your training, but this is big! I have an urgent message from Ereve.
0.1: It says that Empress #p1101000# wants to create a Maple Alliance to stand against the Black Mage. She's holding a continental conference for qualified warriors, to make plans and decide on how to proceed. And she wants YOU to come!
0.2: Everybody knows you're the real deal now! This is so exciting! You should get to Ereve ASAP!

yes.0: The Empress Cygnus is at Ereve.

no.0: Hm? What's with that face? Have you been slacking off in your training? Are you embarrassed to go like this?

1.0: Welcome, sleeper. I've been waiting for you. The time has come for the greatest of Maple World's heroes to combine their forces. I'm sure your memories are still hazy, but I know you can help us.

npc.0: The Empress Cygnus is at Ereve.
